title: Unsloth Dynamic V3 Qwen3.8-27B GGUFs — 10% accuracy gain, 8GB 1-bit path
summary: Unsloth releases Qwen3.8-27B Dynamic V3 GGUF quants claiming over 10% better accuracy on Div-300 and KLD versus other providers, plus 1-bit weights that retain about 77% accuracy on 8GB RAM for laptop-class local agents.
question_it_answers: Which GGUF quants run Qwen3.8-27B locally with better accuracy per gigabyte?

claims.text: Dynamic V3 Qwen3.8-27B GGUFs claim over 10% higher accuracy than other quants on Div-300 and KLD benchmarks.
claims.evidence: Unsloth Dynamic V3 outperforms others by >10% on Div-300, KLD & more benchmarks.
claims.subject: local-inference-models

claims.text: Unsloth also ships 1-bit quants retaining about 77% accuracy runnable on 8GB RAM.
claims.evidence: We also release 1-bit quants that retain 77% accuracy. Run on 8GB RAM.
